title: Gateway of India
blurb: George Wittet’s 1924 triumphal arch at Apollo Bunder: a 26 m Indo-Saracenic gateway in yellow basalt, built for the 1911 landing of King George V and the last British troops’ farewell in 1948.

systems.name: Central arch
systems.description: The great triumphal arch: piers, ten voussoirs, keystone, spandrels and soffit.

systems.name: Central dome
systems.description: The 14.6 m central dome in twelve segments on its drum, with finial.

systems.name: Corner turrets
systems.description: The four corner turrets with latticework shafts, balconies and small domes.

systems.name: Side halls
systems.description: The great halls flanking the arch, each holding about 600 people.

systems.name: Facade ornament
systems.description: Jali latticework panels, medallions, cornice and the commemorative inscription.

systems.name: Flanking arches
systems.description: Four smaller arches flanking the central opening.

systems.name: Platform
systems.description: The raised platform, its steps, the harbor steps and corner pilasters.

systems.name: Parapets
systems.description: Parapet walls and merlons above the main cornice.
